transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Um, I'm here because... well, I just feel like I'm always running hot. Like I can't shut the motor off, you know? It's just constant. And lately, that's been getting me in trouble at the firehouse, so I figured it was time to come in and get some help.

Have there been distinct periods in your life where your energy and mood were significantly higher or lower than your current baseline, or has this 'running hot' feeling been your constant state for as long as you can remember?

No, it's pretty much just always been like this. I don't really have highs and lows or anything like that. It's just a constant... buzz, I guess. I've always been this way, as long as I can remember. Just always on the go, always feeling like I need to be doing something.
Looking back at your time in school as a child, was this feeling of being constantly 'on the go' present back then as well?

Yeah, definitely. My mom says I was exactly like this back in grade school, too. I guess I was always getting out of my seat or... blurting out answers before the teacher even finished asking the question. And I was always losing my homework. She was constantly getting notes sent home from my teachers about it, which was frustrating because they all said I was bright enough to actually do the work. I just couldn't seem to sit still and get it done. So yeah, it's been going on a long time.
